title: Juicy Italian Mentaiko Lasagna
description: A rich and crumbly Italian dish featuring mentaiko, lamination-puff, and raw-friendly ingredients, inspired by Neapolitan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cook the lasagna noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
Roll out the lamination puff pastry to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, combine the ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, and chopped basil.
Add the mentaiko to the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Spread a layer of the cheese mixture on the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Arrange 4 lasagna noodles on top of the cheese mixture.
Spread another layer of the cheese mixture on top of the noodles.
Repeat the layers two more times, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Roll out the puff pastry to fit the top of the baking dish and place it on top of the lasagna.
Brush the puff pastry with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.
